name: Having A Baby Out Of Wedlock
overview: Scripture addresses the serious consequences associated with being born out of wedlock, as seen in Deuteronomy 23:2 where a 'bastard' is excluded from the congregation of the LORD to the tenth generation, highlighting the gravity of this condition in Old Testament law. However, the New Testament offers hope through God's love and redemption, exemplified in John 3:16, which promises everlasting life to all who believe in Christ. Hebrews 12:8 further reminds believers that chastisement is part of God's discipline for His children, contrasting those disciplined with 'bastards' who are not true sons. This study invites believers to understand both the biblical seriousness of the issue and the grace available through faith in Jesus Christ.
